title: harden convergio-bus error mapping — surface 404 / 422 / 500 cleanly
task_body: BusError variants were collapsing to a generic 500 in the server, hiding NotFound and validation problems. Map each variant to a distinct HTTP code, update the lifecycle test, and route ApiError::Bus through the new mapping.
rationale: bus error.rs adds variants; bus.rs returns them; lifecycle test seeds the cases; server error.rs maps to HTTP; e2e_bus asserts the codes.
